beats.text: It's five-forty on the commute. Bitcoin is sliding, and your twenty-x long is four minutes from liquidation.
Your phone is in your pocket. WickSight still finds you, right in Telegram.
Glance up: size, P&L, liquidation. Say "alert sixty-one five", and it's set.
Three trades open? The riskiest comes first.
Say "close half". WickSight shows the exact order before anything moves. The default is No. Swipe to Yes, tap once, and a reduce-only order fills on Binance testnet.
Then the proof: liquidation pushed back, your buffer more than doubled.
Running today in the Even Hub simulator.
Trade-only keys. Withdrawals refused. Nothing moves without your yes. WickSight: see it coming, get out in time.
